answer: Peers audit a 5 percent sample of 100 relay challenges, requiring responses under 200ms against deterministic latency bounds checked by 5 witnesses. One honest agent runs 1 endpoint and passes every sampled check; 10 fakes must maintain 10 distinct pipes, scaling cost linearly. A 150 POA bond is posted per identity; failures slash bonds and freeze repeat offenders. The oasis check binds each trace to its public log, the cipher check rejects copied responses, and the gale check flags same rhythms.
